lines.trans: Well, is everything okay now? Is everything fine?
No, it is not fine, Marina! Now I've gotten all worked up!

words.gloss: to get worked up, to get all nervous

lines.trans: Please, help me! I can't hold it!
Come on, hold it, you're not a child!

words.gloss: to endure, to hold on for a moment

lines.trans: I am not going to do that with my bare hands!

lines.trans: What's wrong with it? A good old glove!
Klavdia Viktorovna, maybe you could? Close the door, please!
Wait, I'm nervous too! I don't want to see anything.
Zipper down, down! Just like that, very good.
Listen, Marina, the two of us have grown closer!
That doesn't mean anything! Listen, are you done?
Yes, I'm done, thank you! Marina, zip up the zipper, please.
Ow, it hurts! You pinched my skin!
I didn't pinch anything! Kindly don't bother me anymore!

беспокоить.gloss: to bother, to disturb; to worry

examples.trans: I don't want to bother you.
We need to do even more.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I can see the toy car.

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Я голыми руками этого делать не буду!
examples.trans: I am not doing that with bare hands!
The door is behind the wardrobe.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

meanings.en: to finish, to end, to complete

examples.trans: I want to finish what I started.

meanings.note: a door, a shop, or a legal case

meanings.en: to fasten, to button, to zip up

examples.trans: Marina, zip up the zipper, please.

meanings.en: to pinch, to catch, to jam
meanings.note: e.g. in a door or zipper

examples.trans: I caught my finger in the door.

meanings.note: что это значит? = what does this mean?
the form значит is used as a linking word

издеваться.gloss: to mock, to kid, to mess with

meanings.en: to mock, to tease; colloquially 'are you kidding me?'
meanings.note: Ты что, издеваешься? = Are you kidding me?

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: Don't be nervous, everything is fine.

meanings.note: usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось
hesitation, at the start of a sentence

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

потерпеть.gloss: to endure, to hold on for a moment

meanings.en: to hold on, to endure for a bit

examples.text: Ну потерпите, вы же не ребёнок!
examples.trans: Come on, hold it, you're not a child!
Hold on for five more minutes.

потрудиться.gloss: to take the trouble, to bother

meanings.note: потрудитесь не беспокоить = kindly don't bother

examples.trans: Kindly do not bother me anymore!

разнервничаться.gloss: to get worked up, to get all nervous

meanings.en: to get worked up, to get nervous

examples.trans: Now I've gotten all worked up!
No need to get so worked up.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
the imperative 'слушай' starts a sentence, like 'look, ...'
спасибо за + accusative = thank you for
at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

meanings.en: to endure, to put up with, to hold it
meanings.note: can mean holding in bathroom need

examples.trans: He endured the pain for a long time.

убрать.gloss: to remove, to take away; to tidy up

meanings.en: to remove, to take away, to cut out

examples.text: Ты можешь убрать весь этот шум?
examples.trans: Can you cut out all this noise?
Take the phone off the table.
If you don't want to, suit yourself.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
